+    ])
+    def test_enable_and_disable_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch,
+                                         parser, enable_source, disable_source):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',

+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        flag = 'disable-features=First,Second'

+        commandline = ['--qt-flag', flag] if via_commandline else []
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args(commandline))
+
+        assert '--' + flag in args
+        assert not any(arg.startswith(qtargs.ENABLE_FEATURES_PREFIX)
+                       for arg in args)
+
+    def test_multiple_feature_flags(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser):

+
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([

+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)

+        assert [arg for arg in args if arg.startswith(
